title: Testing for structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects via discrete Fourier transform
title_zh: 基于离散傅里叶变换的面板数据交互固定效应模型结构变化检验
title_primary: 基于离散傅里叶变换的面板数据交互固定效应模型结构变化检验
title_secondary: Testing for structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects via discrete Fourier transform
authors: Yifei Fang, Zhonghao Fu, Song Han, Xia Wang, Ziran Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based test for detecting structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects (IFE). When structural changes are present but ignored, the conventional asymptotic distribution of the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) may no longer provide reliable inference, and the resulting residuals contain signals of parameter instability. Our test exploits this feature by comparing the DFT of weighted residuals to the flat (zero) spectrum implied under the null hypothesis of no structural change. We establish the theoretical properties of the test, including its asymptotic null distribution and its local and global power, and propose a bootstrap procedure for valid inference in finite samples. Notably, the proposed test can detect a class of local alternatives converging to the null at the rate of N − 1 / 2 T − 1 / 2 , matching the convergence rate of the slope estimators, where N and T are the cross-sectional and time dimensions, respectively. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed test across various types of structural changes in both factor loadings and slope coefficients. We further illustrate the empirical relevance of our method by applying it to the environmental Kuznets curve and the relationship between health expenditure and income. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for structural changes in panel data models with IFE.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的检验方法，用于检测具有交互固定效应（IFE）的面板数据模型中的结构变化。当存在结构变化但被忽略时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量的传统渐近分布可能不再提供可靠的推断，由此产生的残差中包含了参数不稳定性的信号。我们的检验利用这一特性，将加权残差的DFT与无结构变化原假设下隐含的平坦（零）谱进行比较。我们确立了该检验的理论性质，包括其渐近零分布以及局部和全局功效，并提出了一种自助法程序，以在有限样本中进行有效推断。值得注意的是，所提出的检验能够检测一类以N−1/2T−1/2速率收敛于零假设的局部备择假设，这与斜率估计量的收敛速率相匹配，其中N和T分别代表截面维度和时间维度。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的检验在因子载荷和斜率系数的各种结构变化类型下均表现出优异的性能。我们进一步通过将其应用于环境库兹涅茨曲线以及健康支出与收入之间的关系，展示了我们方法的实证相关性。我们的发现强调了在具有IFE的面板数据模型中考虑结构变化的重要性。

title: The role of education in international migration decisions
title_zh: 教育在国际移民决策中的作用
title_primary: 教育在国际移民决策中的作用
title_secondary: The role of education in international migration decisions
authors: Catalina Amuedo-Dorantes, Avinandan Chakraborty
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the effect of education on international migration using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits Mexico’s 1993 compulsory schooling reform, which increased mandatory education from six to nine years. Combining Mexican and U.S. census data, we examine how completing lower secondary education affects migration to the United States during the last major wave of Mexican emigration in the 20th century. We find that completing lower secondary education increases migration to the United States, measured as residence in the United States in 2000, by about 15 percentage points, or roughly five percentage points per additional year of schooling. The effect is larger for men than for women and remains positive across alternative bandwidths and specifications. Moreover, the increase is concentrated in migration associated with work rather than migration associated with school enrollment, consistent with improved labor-market opportunities abroad. The estimates suggest that, where migration corridors are already established, a reform that raises lower secondary completion can also increase international mobility when domestic opportunities are limited.
abstract_zh: 我们利用墨西哥1993年义务教育改革（将强制教育年限从六年延长至九年）作为模糊回归不连续设计的工具，评估教育对国际移民的影响。结合墨西哥与美国的人口普查数据，我们考察了完成初中教育如何影响20世纪最后一次大规模墨西哥移民潮期间向美国的迁移情况。研究发现，完成初中教育使迁往美国（以2000年居住在美国为衡量标准）的概率增加约15个百分点，即每多受一年教育约增加5个百分点。这一效应在男性中更为显著，并在不同带宽和规格设定下保持正向。此外，迁移增加主要集中在与就业相关的迁移，而非与入学相关的迁移，这与海外劳动力市场机会改善相符。估计结果表明，在已有移民通道的地区，当国内机会有限时，提高初中完成率的改革也可能促进国际流动性。

title: Long Rates, Life Insurers, and Credit Spreads
title_zh: 长期利率、寿险公司与信用利差
title_primary: 长期利率、寿险公司与信用利差
title_secondary: Long Rates, Life Insurers, and Credit Spreads
authors: Ziang Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a new channel through which long-term interest rates transmit to credit spreads. When life insurers carry negative duration gaps, higher rates reduce their liabilities more than assets. Rate increases therefore boost equity and risk-bearing capacity, lowering equilibrium credit spreads. Empirically, I test this channel with bond-level yields and a maturity-based discontinuity in bond ownership. Insurers’ trades confirm the mechanism: after rates rise, insurers shift portfolios towards riskier, high-yield bonds. As rates increase, bonds more heavily held by life insurers experience greater spread reductions. The results show that institutional duration mismatch shapes credit spreads and corporate financing conditions. (JEL G12, G22, G23, E50)
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一条长期利率传导至信用利差的新渠道。当寿险公司持有负久期缺口时，利率上升对其负债的减少幅度大于资产，从而提升其股本与风险承担能力，进而压低均衡信用利差。在实证中，我利用债券层面的收益率及基于期限的债券持有断点来检验这一渠道。保险公司的交易行为证实了该机制：利率上升后，保险公司将投资组合转向风险更高、收益率更高的债券。随着利率上升，寿险公司持有较多的债券其利差下降幅度更大。研究结果表明，机构久期错配塑造了信用利差与企业融资条件。（JEL G12, G22, G23, E50）

title: Bounded rationality, monetary policy, and the scars of supply shocks
title_zh: 有限理性、货币政策与供给冲击的疤痕效应
title_primary: 有限理性、货币政策与供给冲击的疤痕效应
title_secondary: Bounded rationality, monetary policy, and the scars of supply shocks
authors: Dario Bonciani, Frantisek Masek, Paolo Nanni, Giulio Tarquini
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Bounded rationality reshapes monetary-policy trade-offs in response to supply shocks in a New Keynesian model with endogenous growth. A negative supply shock depresses innovation and future productivity, which gives rise to long-run scarring and persistent inflationary pressures. Under rational expectations, tighter monetary policy eases the initial rise in inflation but amplifies the fall in demand, innovation, and productivity. Under bounded rationality, households underreact to future income losses. This weakens the negative wealth effect and mitigates the decline in demand and growth. As a result, tighter monetary policy can contain inflation without generating large scarring effects.
abstract_zh: 有限理性重塑了内生增长的新凯恩斯模型中货币政策对供给冲击的权衡取舍。负向供给冲击抑制创新与未来生产率，导致长期疤痕效应和持续的通胀压力。在理性预期下，紧缩性货币政策缓解了初期通胀上升，但加剧了需求、创新和生产率的下降。在有限理性下，家庭对未来收入损失反应不足，这削弱了负财富效应，并缓解了需求与增长的衰退。因此，紧缩性货币政策能够在不产生显著疤痕效应的情况下遏制通胀。

title: Von kultureller Restriktion und autoritärer Radikalität: Eine typologische Analyse der AfD-Wählerschaft
title_zh: 从文化限制到威权激进：德国选择党选民群体的类型学分析
title_primary: 从文化限制到威权激进：德国选择党选民群体的类型学分析
title_secondary: Von kultureller Restriktion und autoritärer Radikalität: Eine typologische Analyse der AfD-Wählerschaft
authors: Teney, Céline
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Über Wähler:innen der AfD dominieren häufig vereinfachende Stereotype: Sie gelten entweder als sozial abgehängte Protestwähler:innen oder als geschlossen radikal rechtes Milieu. Beides greift zu kurz. Das vorliegende Policy Paper zeigt, dass die AfD-Wählerschaft zwar durch migrations- und kulturpolitische Restriktivität verbunden ist, zugleich aber unterschiedliche politische Profile umfasst. Diese unterscheiden sich darin, wie stark Zuwanderungsablehnung mit Autoritarismus, antisemitischen Ressentiments und pessimistischen Einschätzungen der deutschen Wirtschaftslage verknüpft ist. Die Ergebnisse sprechen dafür, im Umgang mit der AfD-Wählerschaft stärker zu differenzieren.
abstract_zh: 关于德国选择党（AfD）选民，常常流行着过于简化的刻板印象：他们要么被视为社会边缘化的抗议选民，要么被视为铁板一块的激进右翼群体。这两种看法都失之偏颇。本政策文件表明，AfD选民虽然因移民和文化政策上的限制性立场而联结在一起，但同时也包含不同的政治面貌。这些差异体现在，对移民的排斥与威权主义、反犹怨恨情绪以及对德国经济形势的悲观评估之间的关联强度各不相同。研究结果支持在与AfD选民打交道时进行更细致的区分。

title: Spatial productivity disparities in Great Britain
title_zh: 英国空间生产率差异研究
title_primary: 英国空间生产率差异研究
title_secondary: Spatial productivity disparities in Great Britain
authors: Mimosa Distefano, Hélène Donnat, Henry G. Overman, Krishan Shah
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study productivity disparities across metropolitan and non‐metropolitan areas in Great Britain. Spatial disparities in productivity are large and persistent. Using a development accounting framework, we show that differences in area size and in the spatial distribution of human and business capital are key explanatory factors. A combination of area size and human capital explains 30% of the productivity variance, increasing to 43–57% once we add measures of business capital stocks. Applying our framework to a case study of Greater Manchester, we show that large increases in both types of capital are needed to narrow productivity disparities with London, illustrating the scale of the challenge for policies aimed at reducing spatial inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国大都市与非大都市地区之间的生产率差异。空间上的生产率差异既大且持久。运用发展核算框架，我们表明区域规模以及人力资本和商业资本的空间分布差异是关键解释因素。区域规模与人力资本的结合解释了生产率变异的30%，而一旦加入商业资本存量指标，这一比例提升至43%至57%。将我们的框架应用于大曼彻斯特的案例研究，我们发现，要缩小与伦敦的生产率差距，需要大幅增加这两类资本，这凸显了旨在减少空间不平等的政策所面临的挑战规模。

title: Prediction with Differential Covariate Classification: Illustrated by Covariate Classification in Medical Risk Assessment
title_zh: 基于差分协变量分类的预测：以医学风险评估中的协变量分类为例
title_primary: 基于差分协变量分类的预测：以医学风险评估中的协变量分类为例
title_secondary: Prediction with Differential Covariate Classification: Illustrated by Covariate Classification in Medical Risk Assessment
authors: Atheendar S. Venkataramani, Charles F. Manski, John Mullahy
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A common practice in evidence-based decision-making uses estimates of conditional probabilities P(y|x) obtained from research studies to predict outcomes y based on observed covariates x. Given this information, decisions are then based on the predicted outcomes. Researchers commonly assume that the predictors used in the generation of the evidence are the same as those used in applying the evidence: i.e., the meaning of x in the two circumstances is the same. This may not be the case in real-world settings. Across a wide range of settings, ranging from clinical practice to education policy, demographic attributes (e.g., age, race, ethnicity) are often classified differently in research studies than in decision settings. This paper studies identification in such settings. We propose a formal framework for prediction with what we term differential covariate classification (DCC). Using this framework, we analyze partial identification of probabilistic predictions and assess how various assumptions influence the identification regions. We apply the findings to a range of settings, focusing mainly on differential classification of individuals' race and ethnicity in clinical medicine. We find that bounds on P(y|x) can be wide, and the information needed to narrow them is available only in special cases. These findings highlight an important problem in using evidence in decision making, a problem that has not yet been fully appreciated in debates on classification in public policy and medicine.
abstract_zh: 循证决策中的常见做法是利用研究获得的条件概率估计值P(y|x)，基于观测到的协变量x来预测结果y。基于这些信息，决策随后依据预测结果制定。研究者通常假设用于生成证据的预测变量与应用证据时所用的预测变量相同：即，两种情境下x的含义一致。然而，在现实环境中情况未必如此。在从临床实践到教育政策的广泛情境中，人口统计学属性（如年龄、种族、民族）在研究中的分类方式往往与决策环境中的分类方式不同。本文研究此类情境下的识别问题。我们提出了一个形式化框架，用于处理我们称之为差异协变量分类（DCC）的预测问题。利用该框架，我们分析了概率预测的部分识别，并评估了各种假设如何影响识别区域。我们将研究结果应用于多种情境，主要聚焦于临床医学中个体种族和民族的差异分类。我们发现，P(y|x)的界限可能很宽，而缩小这些界限所需的信息仅在特殊情况下可得。这些发现凸显了在决策中运用证据时的一个重要问题，这一问题在公共政策和医学分类的讨论中尚未得到充分认识。

title: A structural neural autopilot analysis of social media use around the pandemic lockdown
title_zh: 疫情封锁期间社交媒体使用的结构性神经自动分析
title_primary: 疫情封锁期间社交媒体使用的结构性神经自动分析
title_secondary: A structural neural autopilot analysis of social media use around the pandemic lockdown
authors: Yi Xin, Lawrence J. Jin, Jessica Fong, Colin Camerer
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper estimates a “neural autopilot” model of habit formation using individual-level data on posting behavior from a major Chinese social media platform before, during, and after the 2020 pandemic lockdown. The model yields interpretable parameter estimates for autopilot habit formation and demonstrates that, once habits are neuroscientifically formalized, changes in preferences are no longer required to explain observed behavioral changes. Moreover, the model provides a better fit to the data than both traditional state-dependent habit models and alternative reinforcement learning models. Our analysis further reveals that forced experimentation alone does not generate persistent habitual posting after the lockdown ends. Counterfactual experiments indicate that reducing the volatility of posting rewards, in conjunction with forced experimentation, can significantly strengthen habitual posting on social media. This finding highlights the importance of higher moments of the reward process in creating and sustaining habits.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2020年疫情封锁前后及期间中国某大型社交媒体平台上的个体发帖行为数据，估计了一个习惯形成的“神经自动驾驶”模型。该模型为自动驾驶式习惯形成提供了可解释的参数估计，并表明，一旦习惯以神经科学方式形式化，解释观察到的行为变化便不再需要偏好变化。此外，与传统状态依赖习惯模型及替代性强化学习模型相比，该模型对数据的拟合更优。我们的分析进一步揭示，仅靠强制实验本身并不能在封锁结束后产生持续的习惯性发帖行为。反事实实验表明，降低发帖奖励的波动性，并结合强制实验，能显著增强社交媒体上的习惯性发帖。这一发现强调了奖励过程的高阶矩在创造和维持习惯中的重要性。

title: DP752 Central Banking as a Political Principal-Agent Problem
title_zh: 中央银行作为政治委托-代理问题
title_primary: 中央银行作为政治委托-代理问题
title_secondary: DP752 Central Banking as a Political Principal-Agent Problem
authors: Michele Fratianni, Jurgen von Hagen, Christopher Waller
official: 官方在线 1993-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: An inflation and stabilization bias may arise as a result of the principal-agent nature of monetary policy. Both depend on the degree of political uncertainty and the type of relationship between central bankers and the incumbent political leaders. Specifically, our analysis indicates how a close relationship between central bankers and incumbent political leaders can lead to undesirable outcomes, particularly so during periods of electoral competition and political uncertainty. Various institutional proposals exist for resolving this problem. Our analysis shows that in contrast to Friedman-type policy rules or the appointment of `conservative' central bankers, personal independence of the central banker from government or performance-orientated compensation packages can achieve both optimal stabilization and the elimination of the inflation bias.
abstract_zh: 货币政策的委托-代理性质可能导致通胀偏差和稳定偏差。这两种偏差均取决于政治不确定性程度以及央行官员与现任政治领袖之间的关系类型。具体而言，我们的分析表明，央行官员与现任政治领袖之间的密切关系可能引发不良后果，在选举竞争和政治不确定性时期尤为显著。针对这一问题，现有多种制度性解决方案。我们的分析显示，与弗里德曼式政策规则或任命"保守型"央行官员不同，央行官员相对于政府的个人独立性或基于绩效的薪酬方案，既能实现最优稳定，又能消除通胀偏差。

title: Cisterns, Climate Adaptation, and Economic Development
title_zh: 蓄水池、气候适应与经济发展
title_primary: 蓄水池、气候适应与经济发展
title_secondary: Cisterns, Climate Adaptation, and Economic Development
authors: Barreto, Yuri, Britto, Diogo, Da Mata, Daniel, Emanuel, Lucas, Carrillo, Bladimir 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Over 2 billion people worldwide travel long distances daily to fetch water that is often unsafe for human consumption. This paper studies how lack of water can limit economic development and how families adapt to permanent shifts in water provision in rural areas. It studies a policy providing 1 million rain-fed water cisterns in Brazil's poorest and most drought-prone areas. Using unique individual-level administrative data and a difference-in-differences design, we show that the program substantially improved family welfare. In ten years, household dependency on cash transfers decrease by as much as 19 percentage points while formal labor earnings increase by 15% driven by an increase in off-farm jobs. In turn, hospitalizations due to waterborne diseases declined by 16% among adults and 37% among children, and compliance with cash transfer conditionalities on child health and education improved. Additional evidence suggests that these gains were driven by a relaxation of time constraints: cisterns markedly reduced the time burden of water collection, enabling beneficiaries to allocate more time to productive activities. A cost-benefit analysis indicates a high marginal value of public funds relative to a broad range of public policies.
abstract_zh: 全球超过20亿人每天需要长途跋涉取水，而这些水往往不适合人类饮用。本文研究水资源匮乏如何制约经济发展，以及农村家庭如何适应供水条件的永久性变化。我们聚焦于一项在巴西最贫困且最易干旱地区推广100万个雨水收集蓄水池的政策。利用独特的个人层面行政数据与双重差分法，研究发现该政策显著提升了家庭福利。十年间，家庭对现金转移支付的依赖度下降高达19个百分点，正规劳动收入增长15%，主要源于非农就业岗位的增加。与此同时，成人因水传播疾病住院率下降16%，儿童下降37%，且家庭对现金转移支付中儿童健康与教育附加条件的遵守情况有所改善。进一步证据表明，这些收益源于时间约束的缓解：蓄水池大幅减少了取水时间负担，使受益者能将更多时间投入生产活动。成本收益分析显示，相较于广泛公共政策，该政策的公共资金边际价值较高。

title: Financial Literacy Intervention and the Willingness to Pay for Digital Credits: A Scalable Video‐Based Approach in Kenya
title_zh: 金融素养干预与数字信贷支付意愿：肯尼亚一项可扩展的视频干预方法
title_primary: 金融素养干预与数字信贷支付意愿：肯尼亚一项可扩展的视频干预方法
title_secondary: Financial Literacy Intervention and the Willingness to Pay for Digital Credits: A Scalable Video‐Based Approach in Kenya
authors: Albert Nsengumuremyi, Vanessa Bonke, Oliver Musshoff, Daniel Hermann
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Rapid growth in digital finance has expanded credit access for rural smallholders, yet financial capability has not kept pace with access. Where fee structures are opaque and search is costly, this gap raises the risk of expensive borrowing in digital financial services. This paper assesses whether a video‐based financial knowledge intervention affects stated willingness to pay for digital credit. Using contingent valuation with a payment card approach, we measure willingness to pay before and after information provision among 694 smallholder households in Meru County, Kenya. Our results show that the video intervention reduced the monthly interest rate that smallholders are willing to pay by 1.4 percentage points. This finding suggests that the intervention increased sensitivity to borrowing costs and reduced stated tolerance for higher‐priced digital credit. It also provides policy‐relevant evidence that brief, targeted video prompts can complement consumer‐protection measures by shifting stated credit choices toward lower interest‐rate categories.
abstract_zh: 数字金融的快速发展扩大了农村小农户的信贷获取渠道，但金融能力并未跟上信贷可及性的提升。在费用结构不透明且搜寻成本高昂的情况下，这一差距加剧了数字金融服务中高成本借贷的风险。本文评估了基于视频的金融知识干预是否会影响农户对数字信贷的陈述意愿支付价格。我们采用支付卡法的条件价值评估法，对肯尼亚梅鲁县694户小农户在信息干预前后的支付意愿进行测度。研究结果显示，视频干预使小农户愿意支付的月利率降低了1.4个百分点。这一发现表明，该干预措施提高了农户对借贷成本的敏感度，并降低了其对高息数字信贷的陈述容忍度。同时，该研究提供了具有政策参考价值的证据：简短且有针对性的视频提示能够通过引导陈述信贷选择向低利率类别转移，从而补充消费者保护措施。

title: Slow to Respond: Lagged Adjustments to Moisture Conditions in Small Ruminant Markets
title_zh: 反应迟缓：小型反刍动物市场对水分条件的滞后调整
title_primary: 反应迟缓：小型反刍动物市场对水分条件的滞后调整
title_secondary: Slow to Respond: Lagged Adjustments to Moisture Conditions in Small Ruminant Markets
authors: Musa Hasen Ahmed
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how rural households in Ethiopia adjust their livestock market participation in response to moisture conditions. Using contemporaneous and lagged measures of hydrological stress, the analysis distinguishes between sheep and goat markets to capture species‐specific responses. The results show that adjustment is driven primarily by lagged moisture conditions, although some contemporaneous effects are also evident. Favorable past moisture significantly increases participation in sheep markets, while responses in goat markets are smaller and less consistent. Transaction volumes respond only weakly, indicating that hydrological stress affects primarily the extensive margin of market participation. Responses also vary across agroecological zones. The findings suggest that livestock adjustment to hydrological stress is gradual and species‐specific, reflecting ecological dynamics and differences in resilience across livestock species.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了埃塞俄比亚农村家庭如何根据水分条件调整其牲畜市场参与行为。通过使用同期和滞后的水文压力指标，分析区分了绵羊市场和山羊市场，以捕捉不同物种的特定反应。结果表明，调整主要由滞后的水分条件驱动，尽管部分同期效应也较为明显。过去有利的水分条件显著增加了绵羊市场的参与度，而山羊市场的反应较小且一致性较低。交易量反应较弱，表明水文压力主要影响市场参与的广延边际。不同农业生态区的反应也存在差异。研究结果表明，牲畜对水文压力的调整是渐进且具有物种特异性的，反映了生态动态及不同牲畜物种在韧性上的差异。

title: PFAS contamination disclosures and declining residential land prices in polluted areas of Japan
title_zh: PFAS污染披露与日本污染地区住宅用地价格下跌
title_primary: PFAS污染披露与日本污染地区住宅用地价格下跌
title_secondary: PFAS contamination disclosures and declining residential land prices in polluted areas of Japan
authors: MingYao Wang
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。

title: Digital Safe Havens: The Economics of Tokenized Treasuries
title_zh: 数字避风港：代币化国债的经济学
title_primary: 数字避风港：代币化国债的经济学
title_secondary: Digital Safe Havens: The Economics of Tokenized Treasuries
authors: Chen Lin, Eswar S. Prasad, Daniel Rabetti, Che Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the emerging market for tokenized US Treasuries and yield-bearing dollar instruments on public blockchains. Using a comprehensive dataset that combines on-chain transactions, protocol-level total value locked, pool yields, and monetary policy and stress events, we document three core findings. First, yields can be decomposed into distinct components reflecting issuer fees, lending premia, leverage, basis-trade carry, and collateral pledgability, with the latter generating economically large implicit convenience yields. Second, monetary policy transmission into on-chain dollar markets is highly heterogeneous across product designs, with administratively set rates adjusting slowly and basis-trade-backed instruments displaying economically amplified responses to policy shocks. Third, tokenized Treasuries serve as digital safe havens during episodes of cross-asset stress, attracting large inflows during risk-off events while simultaneously exposing new fragilities arising from the interaction between on-chain composability and off-chain reserve structures, particularly through stablecoin balance sheets. Overall, we provide insights into the distinctive dynamics of pricing, transmission, and fragility of digital Treasuries as decentralized and traditional financial infrastructures increasingly integrate.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了新兴的代币化美国国债及公共区块链上生息美元工具市场。通过整合链上交易、协议级锁定总价值、资金池收益率以及货币政策与压力事件的综合数据集，我们得出三项核心发现。第一，收益率可分解为反映发行人费用、贷款溢价、杠杆、基差交易利差及抵押品可质押性的不同组成部分，其中后者产生了经济意义上显著的隐性便利收益率。第二，货币政策向链上美元市场的传导在不同产品设计间呈现高度异质性：行政设定利率调整缓慢，而基差交易支持的工具对政策冲击表现出经济意义上放大的响应。第三，代币化国债在跨资产压力时期充当数字安全港，在风险规避事件期间吸引大量资金流入，同时暴露出链上可组合性与链下储备结构相互作用所产生的新型脆弱性，尤其是通过稳定币资产负债表。总体而言，随着去中心化与传统金融基础设施日益融合，本文为数字国债在定价、传导及脆弱性方面的独特动态提供了洞见。

title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
title_zh: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病
title_primary: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病
title_secondary: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
authors: Martin Shu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with US data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80)
abstract_zh: 如果具有异质性技能的工人自我选择进入不同部门，服务业劳动生产率增长可能被误测。基于美国数据，本文发现：从制造业重新配置到专业服务业的工人，其收入高于该部门原有工人，但低于教育、卫生和公共服务部门的原有工人。一个广义定量罗伊模型预测，专业服务业中由选择效应导致的劳动生产率增长，比传统选择模型的预测值高出10个百分点。总体而言，选择效应对服务业成本病的贡献微乎其微，这与文献中的假设形成鲜明对比。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80）

title: Environmental Consequences of Hydrocarbon Infrastructure Policy
title_zh: 碳氢基础设施政策的环境后果
title_primary: 碳氢基础设施政策的环境后果
title_secondary: Environmental Consequences of Hydrocarbon Infrastructure Policy
authors: Thomas R Covert, Ryan Kellogg
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The U.S. shale boom has profoundly increased crude oil movements by both pipelines-the traditional mode of transportation-and railroads. This paper develops a model of how pipeline investment and railroad use are determined in equilibrium, emphasizing how railroads' flexibility allows them to compete with pipelines. We show that policies that address crude-by-rail's environmental externalities by increasing its costs should lead to large increases in pipeline investment and substitution of oil flows from rail to pipe. Similarly, we find that policies enjoining pipeline construction would cause 80-90% of the displaced oil to flow by rail instead.
abstract_zh: 美国页岩气繁荣深刻改变了原油运输方式，既包括传统管道运输，也涉及铁路运输。本文构建了一个模型，探讨管道投资与铁路使用如何在均衡中决定，强调铁路的灵活性使其能够与管道竞争。我们表明，通过提高原油铁路运输成本来解决其环境外部性的政策，应导致管道投资大幅增加，并将石油流量从铁路转向管道。同样，我们发现，禁止管道建设的政策将导致80-90%的转移石油改由铁路运输。

title: Government demand and firm growth
title_zh: 政府需求与企业成长
title_primary: 政府需求与企业成长
title_secondary: Government demand and firm growth
authors: Bernard Hoekman, Marco Sanfilippo, Filippo Santi, Rohit Ticku
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Public procurement in developing countries accounts for approximately 13% of GDP, offering a significant market opportunity for domestic firms, especially those facing demand constraints. This paper explores the impact of selling to government entities on firm performance in Uganda, leveraging detailed administrative data and an event study methodology that corrects for firm self-selection and heterogeneity in the timing of the treatment. The results reveal that while firms increase their total sales after entering government contracts, they do not see improvements in productivity (measured by value added per worker). Moreover, sales to non-government customers drop sharply. This reallocation effect is persistent. This effect is not observed when firms start to sell to large private-sector buyers. Drawing on an original survey of firms engaged in public procurement, we highlight potential drivers of these dynamics, including capacity constraints and profitability differences between public and private sector sales.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的公共采购约占GDP的13%，为国内企业，尤其是面临需求约束的企业，提供了重要的市场机遇。本文利用详细的行政数据及一种修正企业自选择和处理时点异质性的事件研究方法，探讨了乌干达企业向政府实体销售对其绩效的影响。结果显示，尽管企业在获得政府合同后总销售额有所增加，但其生产率（以人均增加值衡量）并未得到提升。此外，对非政府客户的销售额急剧下降，这种重新配置效应持续存在。当企业开始向大型私营部门买家销售时，并未观察到这一效应。基于对参与公共采购企业的原始调查，我们强调了这些动态的潜在驱动因素，包括产能约束以及公共部门与私营部门销售之间的盈利差异。

title: The impact of local government fiscal transparency on corporate financing costs: evidence from China
title_zh: 地方政府财政透明度对企业融资成本的影响：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 地方政府财政透明度对企业融资成本的影响：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: The impact of local government fiscal transparency on corporate financing costs: evidence from China
authors: Dawei Liang, Sihan Luan, Qianqian Du, Peixi Miao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-06 · 来源：T&F 备选日期
abstract: Fiscal transparency is widely regarded as an important component of government governance, yet its implications for firms’ financing conditions remain underexplored, particularly at the micro level. Using a panel of 22,715 firm-year observations of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2022, this study examines the effect of local government fiscal transparency on corporate debt financing costs. We employ a two-way fixed effects panel regression framework, combining firm-level financial data from CSMAR and CNRDS with city-level fiscal transparency measures compiled by Tsinghua University. The results show that greater fiscal transparency significantly reduces firms’ cost of debt. Economically, a one – standard deviation increase in fiscal transparency is associated with a decline in borrowing costs of approximately 0.22% points, equivalent to about 3.8% of the sample mean. Mechanism analyses indicate that this effect operates through improvements in both external and internal information environments. The financing cost reduction is more pronounced for firms receiving higher levels of government subsidies or tax incentives. Overall, this study provides novel firm-level evidence that fiscal information disclosure serves as an important macro-institutional determinant of corporate financing outcomes.
abstract_zh: 财政透明度被广泛视为政府治理的重要组成部分，然而其对微观企业融资条件的影响尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2013至2022年间中国A股上市公司22,715个公司-年度观测值的面板数据，考察了地方政府财政透明度对企业债务融资成本的影响。我们采用双向固定效应面板回归框架，将来自CSMAR和CNRDS的公司层面财务数据与清华大学编制的城市层面财政透明度指标相结合。研究结果显示，财政透明度的提高显著降低了企业的债务成本。在经济意义上，财政透明度每增加一个标准差，借款成本约下降0.22个百分点，相当于样本均值的3.8%。机制分析表明，这一效应通过改善外部和内部信息环境得以实现。对于获得较高政府补贴或税收优惠的企业，融资成本的降低效应更为显著。总体而言，本研究提供了新颖的企业层面证据，表明财政信息披露是影响企业融资结果的重要宏观制度性因素。

title: The Rise and Fall of Input Suppliers
title_zh: 投入品供应商的兴衰
title_primary: 投入品供应商的兴衰
title_secondary: The Rise and Fall of Input Suppliers
authors: Unni Pillai
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper presents a model of vertical market structure that integrates multiple determinants previously studied in isolation. It shows how the nature of market growth, whether through existing or new applications of an input, and the type of fixed costs, whether exogenous or endogenous, affect the emergence of external suppliers for the input. The role of such suppliers depends on the input's technological generalizability, its potential for improvement, and the breadth and differentiation among downstream applications. Together, these factors shape whether a vertical market structure persists and can potentially drive multiple transitions between vertical integration and outsourcing.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个整合先前孤立研究的多种决定因素的垂直市场结构模型。该模型揭示了市场增长的性质（通过现有应用或新应用实现投入增长）以及固定成本的类型（外生或内生）如何影响投入品外部供应商的出现。此类供应商的作用取决于投入品的技术通用性、其改进潜力，以及下游应用的广度与差异化程度。这些因素共同决定了垂直市场结构是否持续存在，并可能推动垂直整合与外包之间的多重转型。

title: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
title_zh: 宽松货币政策与金融不稳定
title_primary: 宽松货币政策与金融不稳定
title_secondary: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
authors: Maximilian Grimm, Òscar Jordà, Moritz Schularick, Alan M Taylor
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do periods of persistently loose monetary policy increase financial fragility and the likelihood of a financial crisis? This is a central question for policymakers, yet the literature does not provide systematic empirical evidence about this link at the aggregate level. In this article, we fill this gap by analysing long-run historical data. We find that when the stance of monetary policy is accommodative over an extended period, the likelihood of financial turmoil in the medium term increases considerably. We investigate the causal pathways that lead to this result and argue that credit creation and asset price overheating are important intermediating channels.
abstract_zh: 持续宽松的货币政策时期是否会加剧金融脆弱性并增加金融危机的可能性？这是政策制定者面临的核心问题，然而现有文献并未在宏观层面提供关于这一关联的系统性实证证据。本文通过分析长期历史数据填补了这一空白。研究发现，当货币政策在较长时期内保持宽松立场时，中期内发生金融动荡的可能性显著上升。我们进一步探究了导致这一结果的因果路径，并论证信贷创造与资产价格过热是重要的中介传导渠道。

title: Who buys high and sells low: Trading against expected returns and wealth inequality
title_zh: 谁在高买低卖：逆预期收益交易与财富不平等
title_primary: 谁在高买低卖：逆预期收益交易与财富不平等
title_secondary: Who buys high and sells low: Trading against expected returns and wealth inequality
authors: Jung Sakong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Theories are ambiguous about whether households of higher or lower wealth consistently trade against expected returns. I employ unique matched data on US household trades in the housing market and their wealth to study trade timings and quantify the implications for portfolio returns and wealth inequality. I find that poorer households consistently buy houses when expected returns are low (e.g., after price increases) and sell when expected returns are high (e.g., after price declines). The estimated dispersion in expected portfolio returns from active trades is large, with an interquartile range across the wealth distribution of 65 basis points per year. Back-of-envelope calculations suggest this return dispersion could account for roughly one-fifth of observed wealth concentration beyond what income differences alone explain, within the interquartile range.
abstract_zh: 关于家庭财富水平高低是否一贯地与预期收益反向交易，理论界尚无定论。我利用美国住房市场中家庭交易与其财富的独特匹配数据，研究交易时机，并量化其对投资组合收益及财富不平等的影响。研究发现，较贫困家庭在预期收益较低时（如房价上涨后）一贯购房，而在预期收益较高时（如房价下跌后）出售。主动交易导致的预期投资组合收益离散程度较大，财富分布的四分位距为每年65个基点。粗略估算表明，这一收益离散程度可能解释了在仅考虑收入差异之外，观察到的财富集中现象中约五分之一，且该效应位于四分位距范围内。
